links.comparator_used: LLMs without retrieval augmentation (no RAG), i.e. the model's own knowledge
links.outcome: LLM reliability across MRAG benchmark tasks (English and Chinese medical QA, corpus of Wikipedia and PubMed)
links.effect: RAG enhances LLM reliability across MRAG tasks; RAG also improves usefulness and reasoning quality for long-form questions (no numeric values given in the abstract)
links.tradeoff: LLM responses may become slightly less readable for long-form questions with RAG.
links.quote: (a) RAG enhances LLM reliability across MRAG tasks.
